units.source_text: 将近黎明，天色尚暗，源氏公子便起身准备出门。

en.t: As dawn drew near, while the sky was still dark, Prince Genji rose and prepared to go out.

units.source_text: 其时残月当户，景色清幽，庭中樱花已过盛期，而枝头犹有残红，凄艳可爱。

en.t: At that moment the waning moon shone by the doorway, the scene was quiet and pure, and although the cherry blossoms in the garden had passed their height, a little red still lingered on the branches, mournfully lovely.

units.source_text: 朝雾弥漫，远近模糊，融成一片，这风趣实比秋夜美丽得多。

en.t: Morning mist spread everywhere, blurring near and far into one, and this charm was truly far more beautiful than an autumn night.

units.source_text: 源氏公子靠在屋角的栏杆上，暂时欣赏这般美景。

en.t: Prince Genji leaned against the railing at the corner of the house and for a while enjoyed this beautiful scene.

units.source_text: 中纳言君大约是要亲来送别，开了边门，坐在门口。

en.t: Chunagon no Kimi, perhaps intending to see him off in person, opened the side gate and sat at the entrance.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对她说：“再会之期，想是很难得的了。

en.t: Prince Genji said to her, "The time when we meet again will likely be very hard to come by.

units.source_text: 以前料不到有此世变，因而把随时可以畅聚的年月等闲度过，回想起来实甚可惜！”

en.t: Before, I never imagined such a change in the world, and so I carelessly let pass the years when we could freely meet and enjoy each other's company; thinking back on it now, it is truly a great pity."

units.source_text: 中纳言君默默不答，只是吞声饮泣。

en.t: Chunagon no Kimi gave no answer, but only choked back her voice and wept.
